channel.title: Chemicals: Korean small and mid-cap filings
channel.description: New filings from Korean small and mid-cap companies in the chemicals sector.

item.title: NanoSilikhan Advanced Materials: NanoSilikhan Advanced Materials signed a KRW 1,397,655,000 contract to supply anti-counterfeiting security products to a Middle East government pharma security supplier.
Ecopro HN: Ecopro HN signs KRW 20.0bn greenhouse gas abatement equipment supply contract with Hoffman Construction for Idaho, US.
DL Holdings: DL subsidiary DL E&C won a KRW 406.2bn remodeling contract for Shinsung Shin-an Ssangyong Jinheung Apartments in Suwon.
iFamilySC: Wellient's tender offer for I Family SC drew 3,084,986 shares, below the 3,336,277-share minimum, so no shares were purchased.
Foosung: Hoosung signed a chemical products supply contract worth KRW 71.19bn, equal to 15.10% of recent revenue, with an overseas global chemical company.
SK Chemicals: SK Chemicals reported Q3 2026 standalone preliminary revenue of KRW 402.1bn and operating profit of KRW 16.4bn, down 45.0% year on year.
SK Chemicals: SK Chemicals reported Q3 2026 consolidated revenue of KRW 740.8bn and operating profit of KRW 33.6bn, up 115.6% year on year.
Lotte Chemical: Lotte Chemical reported Q3 2026 consolidated operating loss of KRW 281.4bn (-281,390 million won) on revenue of KRW 5.40tn (5,395,112 million won).
iFamilySC: iFamilySC's board supports Welliant's tender offer for its shares at KRW 12,000 per share, running October 23 to November 11, 2026.
Ecopro HN: Ecopro HN's Q3 2026 preliminary consolidated revenue was KRW 52.8bn, with operating profit up 386.3% year on year.
Dongsung Finetec: Dongsung Finetec signed a KRW 192.3bn contract to supply cryogenic insulation materials for LNG carriers to HD Hyundai Heavy Industries.
EcoGlow: EcoGlow's board decided on Nov 4, 2026 a public paid-in capital increase of 1,031,282 new common shares at KRW 2,909 each.
DL Holdings: DL reported Q3 2026 consolidated revenue of KRW 1,470.0bn and operating profit of KRW 174.0bn, up 59.06% year on year.
Cosmo Advanced Materials & Technology: Cosmo Advanced Materials reported Q3 2026 standalone revenue of KRW 144.1bn, up 36.9% year on year, with operating profit of KRW 1.8bn.
